# QC08: 鉴碧亭 Jianbi Ting

Wave 4 · Qichun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=QC08` · Page: `/scenes/#QC08` · Row: `research/buildings/QC08-jianbi-ting/`

## What it was

鉴碧亭 Jianbi Ting, "Pavilion of the Green Mirror", a square pavilion in the middle of a lake west of 迎晖殿, reached by boat, with 正觉寺 to its west (E0675, E0676). Begun in mid-Jiaqing: a double-eaved square pavilion, three bays a side, with a gallery round it; on the north of the islet the five-bay 天心水面 with annexes and the pavilion 玩鹤; a single-arch stone bridge divided inner and outer water (E0676, E0675). Jiaqing's seven poems run 1811-1820 (E0675). Burned in October 1860 (E0680).

From the inventory row: **built** by 1811 (first dated item); mid-Jiaqing; **destroyed** 1860; rebuilt modern (S06;S49) (S06, S49, S01, S360, S361).

## What survives today

Rebuilt on its site (E0569) and photographed 2012-2026 (P0421, P0422, P0423); the stone arch bridge P0424. A 2007 survey north of 鉴碧亭 found an island edged with stone and three rock piles, 43-86 by 12-81 m, 5872 m2 (E0791); a 2009 survey covered the lake between 正觉寺, 鉴碧亭 and 湛清轩 (E0686, E0687). Rebuilding: Tsinghua's rehabilitation paper R0303.
